items.t: Engine knock and connecting rod bearing failure
items.note: Often free under Hyundai's extended engine warranty (15 years/150,000 miles for bearing damage) if the KSDS update was done. CarComplaints owners report about $3,000 average.

items.t: Connecting rod bearings may wear early (recall)
items.job: Inspect engine, install knock-sensing software, replace engine if damaged

items.t: Dual-clutch hesitation, jerking or limp mode
items.note: Often a software update fixes milder cases at little or no cost.

items.t: Turbo engine damage from pre-ignition (recall)
items.job: Update engine software, inspect engine and repair if damaged

items.t: Panoramic sunroof glass may break (recall)
Panoramic sunroof glass shatters
items.note: May be covered by Hyundai's extended sunroof glass warranty. CarComplaints owners report about $900 average.

items.t: Clunk or click in the steering wheel
items.job: Replace power steering motor rubber coupler
items.note: If the shop replaces the whole steering column instead, expect $600 or more. CarComplaints owners report about $600 average.

items.t: Airbag light, dead horn or steering buttons from a failed clock spring
items.note: Hyundai extended clock spring coverage to 15 years with unlimited miles on covered cars, so ask a dealer first.

items.t: Check engine light for low fuel pressure
Parking brake may not hold or release (recall)
items.job: Inspect and repair rear parking brake mechanism

items.t: 12-volt power outlet can overheat (recall)
Rear parking sensor module can short and catch fire (recall)
ABS module can leak and start a fire (recall)
items.job: Install new ABS fuse per recall

items.t: Key-start cars are easy to steal
items.note: The software upgrade is free. Repairing a damaged ignition lock after a theft attempt costs extra.

items.t: Driver door can open in a side crash (recall)
items.job: Replace driver door latch and window channel

items.t: Engine damage from faulty piston oil rings (recall)
items.job: Install engine-noise software, inspect and replace engine if damaged

items.t: Turbo boost problems from the electric wastegate actuator
items.note: Some cases are fixed with linkage adjustment or software. Covered by the 10-year/100,000-mile powertrain warranty for original owners.

items.t: Check engine light from cold-start misfire or thermostat code
High-pressure fuel pump wear can cause power loss (recall)
items.job: Update engine software and replace high-pressure fuel pump if needed

items.t: Dual-clutch oil pump fault can cut drive power (recall)
items.job: Inspect transmission, replace if needed, update software

items.t: Blind spot warning gives false alerts
items.job: Blind spot radar software update and calibration
items.note: If a radar unit has failed, the part can cost several hundred dollars.
